color.evidence: desktop_fold: h1 is --deep (#012056), filled hero .btn is --action (#013ea8), 'See specification' is a --blue text link - previous heading/button collision is fixed. desktop_s04 contact: solid white quote vs outlined WhatsApp (.btn-ghost), not two white pills. audit: contrast_fail_count 0/76, distinct_bg_colors 5, text_color_count 7, dominant hue 225, no purple. Paper/mist bands ~60/30; action appears as one filled CTA on the fold. --blue #0154a7 and --action #013ea8 remain one hex step apart.
strengths: Headings on --deep; --action reserved for filled CTAs and the inverted contact quote
Paper/mist band rhythm with rare action; chemistry lines stay faint on mist
Blue-tinted neutrals (mist #f2f5f8, ink #243038, muted #3e4c58); 0 contrast failures

issues.problem: #0154a7 and #013ea8 are indistinguishable at a glance, so .link, .btn-ghost, and the header outline CTA still read as one ink.
issues.fix: Keep --blue #0154a7 for links and chemistry; set --action to #012a7a so filled buttons and ghost strokes are a visibly darker family.

issues.problem: Unnamed #c9d3e0 is used for footer body and inner-page leads, outside the 7-token palette plus --line/--void.
issues.fix: Add --fog: #c9d3e0 and replace both #c9d3e0 literals with var(--fog).

issues.problem: Plant/sales labels use opacity:.8 on white instead of a named on-deep muted, so hierarchy is a washout not a token.

spacing_rhythm.evidence: audit spacing_grid_adherence 100% (was 41.5%), spacing_distinct 9 (was 16), distinct_radii 1, distinct_shadows 0. --s1---s8 (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/80) drive section padding (--s7 mobile, --s8 at 1024px) and 5/6 .cols. desktop_s04 #who: .cols applied (previous empty stack partly fixed) but --s8 padding still frames ~3 lines of type plus an empty 6fr column. Plant/qc inline margin-top:1.25rem adds a 20px value off the named scale.
strengths: Shared --s8 section padding and 5/6 .cols across uses/spec/plant/qc
Flat industrial: one 4px radius, no shadows, borders only on header/place/tables

issues.problem: Chairman bio is still a short block in 80px padding; the right 6fr column holds only the about link, leaving a large empty field above the contact band (partly fixed by .cols, empty field remains).
issues.fix: Remove .cols on this section, stack the about link under the paragraph with gap: var(--s4), and set padding-block: var(--s6) at desktop. Alternative: fill the second column with CIN U24297DN2019PTC005589 and 16 November 2019.

issues.where: index.html plant table/link; quality link; .steps li
issues.problem: Inline margin-top:1.25rem (20px) and .steps padding 1.1rem (17.6px) sit off the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/80 scale and account for the 9th distinct value.
issues.fix: Replace every 1.25rem margin with var(--s5); replace 1rem quality-link margin with var(--s4); replace .steps 1.1rem/2.75rem with var(--s4) and var(--s6).

issues.problem: columns:2 with column-gap: var(--s7) on only three items leaves a hole in the uses block (desktop_s01/s02).
issues.fix: Use display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap: var(--s2). If two columns are required, use 1fr 1fr with gap: var(--s3) var(--s6).

issues.problem: gap:.5rem bypasses the spacing tokens even though 8px equals --s2.
